correctness.rationale: For N uniform spacings the exact Dirichlet first and second moments yield 1+C² = Γ(N+α)²/[Γ(N)Γ(N+2α)]·[1+(Bα−1)/N], Bα=Γ(1+2α)/Γ(1+α)². For α=c log N, c>0 fixed, Stirling gives C²~4^α/(N√(πα)), including α=(log N+0.5loglog N)/log4+x and its stated finite limit. Representing Δ_j=E_j/ΣE_l with iid Exp(1), log-scale truncation of W=Σ E_j^α at b log N proves W/EW→1 for c<1 and →0 for c>1; a split at logN ± KloglogN and the Gamma central limit theorem proves W/EW→Φ(−s) when α=logN+s√logN. Normalization ΣE_j/N changes this by o_P(1). Independent exact Dirichlet arithmetic and high-precision critical-window checks passed. No uniformity outside the stated fixed-c or fixed-s regimes is proved.
